sourceText:
Mediterranean Tomato Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 12:14am

Ingredients




4 Tomatoes, thinly sliced
1 lrg Cucumber,
1/4 cup Black olives, sliced
1/4 cup Scallions, thinly sliced
1 cup Celery, sliced
1/4 cup Mint, chopped
3 tablespoons Parsley, chopped
2 cl Garlic, minced
1/4 cup Olive oil,
2 tablespoons Lemon juice,
3/4 teaspoon Salt,
Black pepper,to taste

Preparation

1 Place tomatoes in a large serving dish. Peel the cucumber. Halve lengthwise, seed & slice thinly. Add to the tomatoes. Add the remaining salad ingredients, toss & set aside. 2 DRESSING: Whisk together all the dressing ingredients in a small bowl. Pour this dressing over the salad, toss gently & refrigerate until ready to use.
